name: B10-0244/2026 – After recital E – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need to reduce work-related fatalities
part_text: Ea. whereas Eurostat data1a consistently show that men represent the overwhelming majority of victims of fatal workplace accidents in the EU, accounting for more than 90 % of such fatalities; whereas workplace health and safety strategies should therefore take proper account of sectoral and sex-specific exposure to physical occupational risks; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Eurostat, ‘Fatal accidents at work per 100 000 workers, by sex’, [https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/sdg\_08\_60/default/table?lang=en](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/sdg_08_60/default/table?lang=en).
